title: When Passing Checks Do Not Establish Completion: Evidence Interpretation in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.22835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Verification procedures in coding agents must preserve execution facts, interpret their scope and discharge checking obligations. We study these responsibilities through qualified repository checks, controlled evidence consumers and executable workflows. A prospective thirteen-task factorial study finds that correct reported facts need not yield the requested finite verdict. Conversely, all 122 delivered labels in a held-out receipt-supply study are correct, while sixteen responses misreport facts and eleven others exceed authorized scope. Production repair supplies successful controls and finite-supported preservation failures. Across 118 repair episodes on 31 tasks, source interventions separate startup reachability from repair and witness production from the claimed operation. Lifetime and resource controls delimit what passing validation establishes. Generated-note comparisons yield local repair differences but can state false explan

translated_title: 当通过检查并不能确立任务完成时：编程智能体中的证据解释
translated_abstract: 编程智能体中的验证程序必须保留执行事实、解释其范围并履行检查义务。我们通过合格的仓库检查、受控的证据消费者和可执行的工作流来研究这些职责。一项前瞻性的十三任务因子研究发现，正确报告的事实未必能得出所请求的有限结论。相反，在一项留出的回执供应研究中，所有122个交付的标签都是正确的，但有十六个回复误报了事实，另有十一个回复超出了授权范围。生产修复实验提供了成功的对照组以及有限支持的保留失败案例。在31个任务上的118次修复事件中，源码干预将启动可达性与修复区分开来，并将见证生成与所声明的操作区分开来。生命周期和资源控制界定了通过验证所能确立的范围。生成说明的比较显示出局部修复差异，但可能陈述错误的解释。
tldr: 该研究通过因子实验与118次修复事件分析证明：编程智能体中检查通过并不等同于任务完成，正确报告的执行事实未必能导出所请求的有限结论，部分回复还存在误报事实或超出授权范围的问题。
